evaluation: Residuals reported separately for measured fitting and withheld observations
method: Evaluate the exact shared motion core at each original source PTS, subtract measured padded-template geometry; rejected observations remain present with null residuals

units.bottom: px; template bottom proxy, not a typographic baseline

fixedConstraints.x: Fixed manual template x; not independently remeasured per frame
fixedConstraints.w: Fixed manual template width; not dynamic glyph ink width
fixedConstraints.h: Fixed manual template height; not dynamic glyph ink height
fixedConstraints.bottom: y plus fixed h; duplicates vertical displacement rather than independently locating a font baseline

role: Historical within-sequence odd-frame holdout diagnostic of the earlier even-only model. This is NOT independent validation of the final all-point reconstruction.
finding: Large outgoing-block endpoint errors occur where the final accepted odd sample follows the last even calibration knot and the sparse model clamps. All original observations and errors are retained.
